about.title: About ISIPPE-3
about.body: The International Symposium on Intellectual Property Protection and Enforcement (ISIPPE-3) is a premier global forum bringing together government agencies, industry leaders, policy makers, experts and stakeholders to discuss and advance strategies for combating counterfeiting and strengthening intellectual property protection and enforcement.
